turn.content: The PO price is 817,200; the invoice bills 911,500. The only contract price change (clause 11.1, effective 2026-09-17) applies to Whiteboard 120x240, not to this toner line. So no contract clause authorises the higher toner price.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0146", "detail": "Line 1 'Black Laser Printer Toner' ordered at unit price 817200 (qty 6)."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "INV-EOS-00546", "detail": "Line 1 bills unit price 911500, i.e. 94300 per unit above the PO price (566,100 excess on 6 units)."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-026#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices are fixed in Schedule A for the term."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-026#2.2", "detail": "Price changes only via a signed written addendum, never retroactively."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-026#11.1", "detail": "The only addendum price change (from 2026-09-17) concerns Whiteboard 120x240 at IDR 1,350,000, not this toner line."}], "explanation": "The invoice unit price of 911500 exceeds the PO price of 817200 for this toner line and no contract clause or addendum authorises a higher price for it, so the excess is an overcharge."}]}
